items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: the girl came to me and said, Happy, said, why don't you go and see Hawk? ... She said, well, he always asking about you.

ctx.x: Yeah, it is. His daughter is a secretary to where his body was laid out in 141st, St. Nicholas

[Baptist] funeral parlor. His daughter was working there at the same time, when he passed. But we were down there at the River Boat. That's when they gave this thing for Red Allen, and Louie Metcalf was in charge of it. So I went down with Jimmy Rushing, couple of us together, and so the girl came to me and said, Happy, said, why don't you go and see Hawk? I said, I can't catch up with him. She said, well, he always asking about you. I said, well, where is he living? I said, well, they told me one place, go…
